title: Colorectal cancer-associated PCBP1 mutations disrupt protein stability in a dominant-negative manner.
authors: Blinkiewicz, Paige V; Hoenes, Nicole C; Afzal, Myra X; Liu, Yihong; Hill, Ulysses J; Trafton, Sophie K; Bjarnadottir, Berglind; Burgin, T Emme; Malaney, Prerna
one_liner_zh: 该文研究结直肠癌相关RNA结合蛋白PCBP1突变通过分子动力学模拟揭示其破坏蛋白稳定性及显性负效应，虽涉及蛋白-RNA互作而非TF-DNA体系，但MD方法可迁移至蛋白-核酸互作机制研究。
abstract: Mutations in RNA-binding proteins are increasingly identified in cancers through tumor sequencing and are correlated with disease progression, therapy response, and overall patient outcomes, underscoring the need to study them. Here, we focus on the RNA-binding protein Poly-C binding protein 1 (PCBP1), which binds target RNAs through K-homology (KH) domains to regulate RNA fate. PCBP1 is a tumor suppressor gene and hotspot missense mutations at leucine residues 100 and 102 are observed in colorectal cancer (CRC). PCBP1 mutations have been recurrently reported in CRC genome-wide mutation studies and are associated with poor clinical outcomes; however, their effects on PCBP1 expression and function remain largely unexplored. We show that cancer-associated mutations substituting leucine 100 and 102 with glutamine, proline, or arginine destabilize PCBP1. The L100/L102 residues occur at the interface of the RNA-binding KH1 and KH2 domains, and our molecular dynamics simulations show that mutations at these residues disrupt the secondary structure of PCBP1. Additionally, these mutants display increased cytoplasmic localization. Importantly, mutant PCBP1 physically interacts with wild type PCBP1 and suppresses its expression through a dominant-negative mechanism. Together, our data demonstrate that CRC-associated PCBP1 mutations destabilize the protein and act as dominant-negative variants, revealing a novel mechanism of tumor suppressor inactivation in colorectal cancer.
abstract_zh: 通过肿瘤测序，RNA结合蛋白的突变在癌症中被越来越多地识别，并与疾病进展、治疗反应及患者总体预后相关，凸显了研究这些突变的必要性。在此，我们聚焦于RNA结合蛋白多聚胞嘧啶结合蛋白1（PCBP1），该蛋白通过K同源（KH）结构域结合靶RNA以调控RNA命运。PCBP1是一个肿瘤抑制基因，在结直肠癌（CRC）中观察到亮氨酸残基100和102处的热点错义突变。PCBP1突变在CRC全基因组突变研究中被反复报道，并与不良临床结局相关；然而，这些突变对PCBP1表达和功能的影响在很大程度上仍未探索。我们表明，将亮氨酸100和102替换为谷氨酰胺、脯氨酸或精氨酸的癌症相关突变会使PCBP1不稳定。L100/L102残基位于RNA结合KH1和KH2结构域的界面，我们的分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟显示，这些残基的突变破坏了PCBP1的二级结构。此外，这些突变体表现出细胞质定位增加。重要的是，突变型PCBP1与野生型PCBP1发生物理相互作用，并通过显性负效应机制抑制其表达。综合来看，我们的数据表明，CRC相关的PCBP1突变使蛋白质不稳定并作为显性负效应变体发挥作用，揭示了结直肠癌中肿瘤抑制基因失活的新机制。
